title: Ends of Critical Long-Range Percolation Clusters
statement: In one-dimensional long-range percolation with edge probabilities asymptotic to $\beta|k|^{-s}$, are both of the following true at $s=2$: at criticality the infinite cluster has exactly two ends, and in the supercritical regime it has infinitely many ends?
